job0.company: Municipal Department of Urban Planning and Licensing (SMUL)
job0.description: I work as a Developer at SMUL, building scalable web applications to automate internal municipal workflows. Agile environment working with Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and Prisma with NestJS.
job0.description2: Systems Digitalization: modernizing the Subvenção 2026 system and restructuring the new CAF system. Author of SMUL Design System and shared UI library (React, Next.js, Storybook, shadcn/ui). Developing the new Intranet and revamped the CIPA portal. Reusable CMS architecture with Payload CMS and Next.js.

job1.description: Building a FinOps SaaS product for AI and cloud infrastructure cost auditing, democratizing FinOps for startups and turning complex business logic into high-performance web applications.
job1.description2: Interactive FinOps dashboards displaying potential savings and cost trends. Brazilian neo-brutalist Design System using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Full backend integration with Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, and Storage). AI agent pipeline monitoring and billing upload UI. Subscription monetization via Stripe and AbacatePay.

job4.description: Worked on developing modern, dynamic, and responsive interfaces using React.js and CSS, ensuring intuitive user experience, reusable components, and accessibility.
job4.description2: Storybook story creation and maintenance for component documentation. Version control with GitLab and agile workflows with Kanban in Jira. Learning and practicing Kotlin.

job5.description: Front-end development with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Material UI, creating responsive, intuitive user interfaces aligned with design system guidelines.
job5.description2: Component styling with Tailwind CSS and Material UI. State management using React Hooks. API communication with Axios and strict prop typing.

job6.description: Front-end engineer on PicPay Invest, creating engaging, intuitive, and responsive interfaces for financial platform users.
